name: last-mile-delivery-tracker
description: Last-mile delivery tracker — API and dashboard served from one Node process in production.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.db:deploy: npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm --prefix server run seed:prod
